tasks.prompt: Two people in one household share a cat, and the cat's profile is on both of their Pawpoint accounts. May the second person book a vaccination for the cat from their own account in the app?
tasks.notes: Yes: the pet is on the booker's own account (shared pets can be booked from either account).

tasks.notes: Managers can override most rules, but not this one.

tasks.notes: Gate conditions are met and the manager agrees; a clinic can join late if its manager asks.

tasks.notes: cross-section: the limit (Booking rules) plus the interim rule that nurse checks count (Open questions).

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-b
tasks.prompt: Explain in a few sentences what an owner pays, and when, after booking a visit online and then cancelling it or missing it.

rubric.text: No money is taken at booking; the card is saved with the payment provider (there is no deposit).
A €20 fee is charged if the owner cancels less than 24 hours ahead or does not turn up; cancelling earlier is free.
No fee when the clinic cancels or when the owner cancels because the pet has died.
The fee is never charged for a post-op check.
The clinic manager can waive the fee from the staff portal.

tasks.notes: cross-section: Booking rules (no-fee cases) and the Decision log (fee replaces deposit).

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-b
tasks.prompt: Which lines must change to make a slot hold last 10 minutes instead of 7?
tasks.notes: cross-section: Booking rules prose, the booking flow diagram and the Hold a slot API description.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-b
tasks.prompt: Explain which visits owners cannot book in the Pawpoint app in the first release, including any exceptions.

rubric.text: Visits for exotic animals, birds and farm animals are not bookable online; they stay phone only.
Exception: a post-op check can be booked online at the clinic that did the surgery, within 14 days of the operation.
First vaccinations for puppies and kittens under 8 weeks cannot be booked online.
Euthanasia is never offered in the app; the clinic phone number is shown instead.

tasks.notes: cross-section: Goals and non-goals, Appointment types.
